evidence.detail: Commit message: 'Determine a deck's colors in a more sophisticated way — This will prevent Kellan, Daring Traveler giving a bunch of WW decks a green stripe in their mana bar'
`colors_in_every_cost = set.intersection(*card_colors)` — for Kellen ({W}{U} creature side, {1}{G} adventure side), intersection is empty set, so no colors contributed
mana_cost_query() stores adventure cards with pipe-separated costs (GROUP_CONCAT…SEPARATOR '|'), so both faces' costs are correctly available for the intersection calculation

triage.notes: Issue filed 2024-05-16; fix landed 8 days later on 2024-05-24. The commit message explicitly names 'Kellan, Daring Traveler' (same card, slightly different spelling). Issue remains open despite being resolved.
triage.proposed_comment: This was fixed by commit 0f1ac991 (2024-05-24), which changed deck color determination to use the intersection of colors across all mana costs rather than the union. For adventure cards like Kellen with {W}{U} (creature) and {1}{G} (adventure), the intersection is empty, so no green stripe appears.
